# pcd_networking_floatingip (Data Source)

Look up a floating IP by address or filters. Exactly one floating IP must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a floating IP by its address.
data "pcd_networking_floatingip" "example" {
  address = "203.0.113.42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String) Filter by (and report) the floating IP address.
- `description` (String) Filter by (and report) the description.
- `fixed_ip` (String) Filter by (and report) the mapped fixed IP.
- `floating_network_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the external network ID.
- `port_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the associated port.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `status` (String) Filter by (and report) the operational status.
- `tenant_id` (String) Filter by (and report) the owning project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The floating IP ID.
- `router_id` (String) The router through which the floating IP is routed.
